title: unified-rollouts-probing-staged-shadow-ab-autorollback-enhancements
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: improve stability and observability of staged shadow+canary A/B rollouts by adding probing phases, better metric matching, and automated rollback safety guards. This PR introduces a probing-staged workflow that performs low-volume traffic probing to gather cold-start and distributional metrics before promoting canary traffic, extends the autorollback engine to support composite metrics and time-weighted thresholds, and adds e2e and unit tests plus new tracing hooks. Changes include config surface additions for probing schedule, a new metric-matching policy, enhanced rollback hysteresis to avoid flapping, and observability panels for rollout health. Checklist: - [x] Implement probing scheduler and controller - [x] Extend autorollback engine with composite metrics - [x] Add metric-matching heuristics and time-weighted windows - [x] Wire tracing and rollout events to observability backend - [x] Add unit and e2e tests covering probing edge cases - [x] Update docs and API spec Notes: kept backward compatibility for existing rollout specs; added defaults that preserve previous behavior if probing is not enabled; documented intended trade-offs in the rollout reference page.
commits_summary: Initial scaffold for probing controller and CRD changes; autorollback: add composite-metric evaluator and time-weighted thresholds; rollout-controller: integrate probing phase and scheduling; observability: add rollout_probe events and dashboards; tests: add unit tests for metric matching, e2e for staged probe happy/path and rollback; fix flake in existing canary e2e; docs: rollout reference and migration notes.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: The probing scheduler looks good but we need clearer limits on probe concurrency to avoid overloading lightweight backends. Can you add a maxConcurrentProbes config?
Aisha Kapoor: Added maxConcurrentProbes with a sane default (2) and documented it in docs/migration.md
Lina Chen: Observability events are helpful. Can we include a probe_id in the rollout_probe event for easier correlation?
Aisha Kapoor: probe_id added; events include rollout name, probe_id, sample_count, and composite metric snapshot
Marcus Wolfe: Unit tests look solid. I saw a flake in the e2e where the probe sample window overlaps warmup; suggest adding a small stable window in the scheduler to avoid nondeterminism
Aisha Kapoor: Implemented a stableWindow parameter and added an e2e assertion to ensure the probe window does not overlap warmup; reran e2e and fixed one flake
Priya Desai (approver): LGTM after tests pass and minor doc nits fixed
ci_checks: e2e-rollouts: pass (rerun once due to flaky probe timing)
merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge. Author rebased to main to fix merge conflicts, CI green on final run. Changelog entry created and migration docs included.
release_notes: Enhancement: Add probing-staged rollout workflow that performs low-volume probing before canary promotion; Autorollback: support composite metrics and time-weighted thresholds; Observability: rollout_probe events with probe_id and new dashboard panels; Migration: new ProbingSpec defaults preserve prior behavior if not enabled.
notes: Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs remain valid. Operators may enable probing via ProbingSpec in rollout manifest; default probing disabled. Monitoring teams should add new dashboard panels to track probe latency, sample distribution, and composite metric drift.
